# FG-AUTH-0024

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `the_bot_may_not_push_to_a_protected_source_branch` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自動修正のボットはこの MR のブランチに書けません（保護されたブランチ、作成者・有効にした人の権限、または自動修正が無効）。
- en: The automatic fix bot may not write to this merge request's branch (a protected branch, the author's or the enabler's role, or autofix is turned off).
- id: Bot perbaikan otomatis tidak boleh menulis ke branch merge request ini (branch dilindungi, peran pembuat atau pengaktif, atau perbaikan otomatis dimatikan).

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C14 (ADR-0017 §2.5): `authorize(RepoPush)` on `Resource::Autofix` refused the bot — before git was read (the attempt's start) or under the merge request's lock at landing. `cause_reason`: `autofix_protected_branch` (the source branch is protected: the bot never writes one), `autofix_author_role` / `autofix_enabler_role` (the merge request's author, or the person who enabled autofix, is no longer an active Developer or above), `autofix_disabled`, `autofix_merge_request_not_open`, `autofix_not_fast_forward`, `source_equals_target`, `pending_deletion`. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge.autofix.denied` (warn) with `attempt_id`, `stage` (start / land), `cause_reason`. SELECT * FROM forge.project_autofix WHERE project_id = <id>; the protection rules of the project's source branch.

## 対処 (fix)

Expected for a protected source branch (work on a feature branch). For a lost role, the author or the enabler needs Developer again, or a Maintainer turns autofix off and on (becoming the enabler).
